articles.title: Woman wounded in Rogers Park shooting
articles.description:
A woman was grazed in the head by a bullet late Sunday during a fight in the Rogers Park neighborhood, according to police.

The altercation between the woman, 27, and a man took place about 10:30 p.m. in the 7700 Block of North Paulina Street, Chicago police said in a statement.

The man took out a gun and fired shots, grazing her in the head, police said. The woman was taken to Saint Francis Hospital in Evanston in good condition, police said. Police reported no arrests.
